LVEF 30% on bedside TTE at the first facility and 30.3% on TTE after arrival are separate studies and are not merged; the abstract LVEF and NT-proBNP statements are attributed to the time of transfer and are represented by the arrival laboratory and TTE facts.

The cause of the cardiomyopathy is described only as likely associated with prolonged ritodrine infusion; this hedged statement is not recorded as an asserted cause, and the title and abstract link are not turned into a causal relation.
Whether T-CM or PPCM and whether atrial tachycardia or atrial flutter were present is stated only as either/or; neither alternative is asserted.

The screening-ECG result is kept review_only; the literal 'no prior history of arrhythmia' and the authors' modified WHO class 1 assignment are recorded as stated, without inferring a documented normal baseline ECG.

The bisoprolol return to 2 mg/d printed in Figure 4 is likewise not a fact.
